name: SavvyCal
description: SavvyCal is a scheduling platform that lets recipients overlay their own calendar on a scheduling link, making it easier to find a time that works for everyone.
best_for: Sales, recruiting, customer success, and consulting professionals who want a more collaborative, less chaotic scheduling-link experience.
features: Scheduling links with a week-view booking interface
Calendar overlay so recipients can see their own events while booking
Buffers, quantity caps, and time-blocking to protect focus time
Collective mode combining multiple colleagues' availability
Round robin mode for distributing meetings across a team
Group mode for multiple attendees per time slot
Custom branding and custom domain hosting

alternatives.name: Calendly
alternatives.description: A scheduling tool that lets people share availability links to book meetings without back-and-forth emails.
alternatives.best_for: Individuals and teams booking one-off or recurring meetings

alternatives.name: Cal.com
alternatives.description: An open-source scheduling infrastructure platform for building booking flows.
alternatives.best_for: Developers and businesses wanting customizable, self-hostable scheduling

alternatives.name: YouCanBook.me
alternatives.description: An online scheduling tool with branded booking pages, automated reminders, and payment collection.
alternatives.best_for: Small businesses and consultants automating client booking
